source.text_layer: hybrid (CAR p.1-26 text; financial statements from p.27 scanned)

notes: File named TIPLIFE: the cover of the financial statements (p.27) reads บริษัท ทิพยประกันชีวิต จำกัด (มหาชน), i.e. Dhipaya Life Assurance. Hybrid file: CAR disclosure p.1-26 has a text layer, the financial statements from p.27 are scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Face and notes in Baht. No PAA business. Issued contracts are reported in two portfolio groups: note 9 (ordinary and others) and note 10 (credit group). Revenue and expenses from 8.1 total column (p.81 2568, p.82 2567). CSM roll-forward = sum of the CSM columns of 9.2 (p.86 2568, p.87 2567) and 10.2 (p.92 2568, p.93 2567); new business = sum of the totals of 9.3 (p.88) and 10.3 (p.94), both years on each page. Each summed item records the note 9 page; the heading names the note 10 page. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). Other revenue = รายการอื่น (8.1). Other expense = other operating expenses (no separate other finance cost line).
